about.metaDescription: Learn about Gentleman's Choice — our story, our team, and our commitment to premium grooming in Ljubljana, Slovenia.
about.pageSubtitle: Our story, our team, our craft
about.paragraph1: Gentleman's Choice was born in the heart of Ljubljana in 2012, founded by master barber Marcus James with a single vision: to bring world-class grooming to the city he calls home. What started as a one-chair shop on Čopova ulica has grown into one of Ljubljana's most respected barbershops, known for precision cuts, immaculate fades, and an atmosphere that feels like home.
about.paragraph2: We believe a great haircut is more than a service — it's a ritual. Every client who sits in our chair is treated to an experience rooted in skill, patience, and attention to detail. Our barbers train continuously, blending time-honored techniques with the latest trends to ensure every cut is tailored to you.
about.paragraph3: Community is at the core of everything we do. From sponsoring local youth programs to hosting free grooming days for those in need, Gentleman's Choice is committed to giving back to Ljubljana in the same spirit it gave to us.

marcusJames.name: Marcus James
marcusJames.bio: With over 15 years behind the chair, Marcus is the founder of Gentleman's Choice and the creative force behind our signature styles. He specializes in precision fades and has trained barbers across Ljubljana.

daniReyes.name: Dani Reyes
daniReyes.bio: Dani brings 8 years of experience and a passion for blending classic techniques with modern trends. Known for immaculate beard work and hair designs, she has a loyal following of clients.

tylerBrooks.name: Tyler Brooks
tylerBrooks.bio: A rising talent with 2 years of experience, Tyler graduated top of his class from barber school. He excels at taper fades and is always pushing his craft with new techniques.
